run_partition_server: run a partition server for distributed PyTorch BigGraph training with a given config and rank
run_partition_server_cli: run the partition server CLI with a config file path and optional rank argument
run_sharded_partition_server: run a sharded partition server when num_partition_servers exceeds num_machines in the config
run_parameter_server: run a standard parameter server for distributed training with trainer and partition server groups
review_run_partition_server: review the run_partition_server function to understand process group initialization and server startup logic
